panels.title: Security alerts — triage queue (domain=security)
panels.description: Firing/pending security-domain rules. This IS the actionable queue; each routes to ntfy /security (warning) or pages (critical after soak).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS value FROM suricata.alert WHERE Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE AND alert_severity = 1 AND alert_signature_id NOT IN (0)
SELECT count() AS value FROM suricata.alert WHERE Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND alert_severity IN (1,2) AND alert_signature_id NOT IN (0)
SELECT count() AS value FROM zeek.notice WHERE Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR

SELECT sum(d)/900 AS value FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d)) AS d FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 25 MINUTE AND TimeUnix <= now() AND MetricName='hubble_drop_total' AND Attributes['reason']='POLICY_DENIED' WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE

SELECT Timestamp as time, alert_severity as severity, alert_signature as signature, alert_category as category, toString(src_ip) as src_ip, dest_port, toString(dest_ip) as dest_ip FROM suricata.alert WHERE Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND alert_severity IN (1,2) ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Runtime · Image · HIDS · Identity — Tetragon / Trivy / Wazuh / Keycloak
Tetragon escape signal (15m)
panels.description: Escape-class eBPF policy hits (page-class after soak).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS value FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name']='tetragon' AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.name']='export-stdout' AND JSONExtractString(Body,'process_kprobe','policy_name') IN ('tetragon-host-runtime-socket','tetragon-kernel-module-load','tetragon-unprivileged-userns-create')

SELECT count() AS value FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name']='tetragon' AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.name']='export-stdout' AND match(Body,'tetragon-(sensitive-file-access|privilege-escalation|mount-namespace-ops)') AND isValidJSON(Body)

SELECT count() AS value FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE AND ServiceName='intrusion-detection-stack' AND JSONExtractString(Body,'CONTAINER_NAME')='wazuh' AND toFloat64OrNull(JSONExtractString(JSONExtractString(Body,'MESSAGE'),'rule','level')) >= 12

SELECT count() AS value FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND ServiceName='keycloak' AND LogAttributes['log.file.name']='keycloak.log' AND position(Body,'LOGIN_ERROR')>0

panels.title: Trivy critical vulns — backup=critical / public namespaces
panels.description: Critical CVEs on images in backup-critical or public-exposure namespaces.

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.namespace AS namespace, t.image_repository AS image_repository, c.backup AS backup, c.exposure AS exposure, t.value AS value FROM (SELECT namespace, image_repository, max(value) AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['namespace'] AS namespace, Attributes['image_repository'] AS image_repository, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='trivy_image_vulnerabilities' AND Attributes['severity']='Critical' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes, ResourceAttributes, ServiceName) GROUP BY namespace, image_repository) t INNER JOIN aether.namespace_contract c ON c.namespace = t.namespace WHERE c.backup='critical' OR c.exposure='public' ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT Timestamp as time, note, msg, toString(src) as source_ip, toString(dst) as dest_ip FROM zeek.notice WHERE Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 50

options.content:
### Where these findings go & how to dig in

- **Routing:** every rule here carries `domain=security` → Alertmanager route 5 → **ntfy `/security`** (digest) or **pages** when `severity=critical` (after 14-day soak).
- **IDS drill-down:** [IDS Monitoring dashboard](/d/ids-monitoring) — Suricata signatures, Zeek conn/dns/http/ssl/ssh/files/notices.
- **Host posture:** [Fleet](https://fleet.home.shdr.ch) — osquery policy pass/fail across 9 enrolled hosts.
- **Alert rules & state:** [Grafana Alerting](/alerting/list?search=label:domain%3Dsecurity).
- **Raw forensics (no alert):** Explore → ClickHouse (`zeek.*`, `suricata.*`, `otel.otel_logs` for tetragon/wazuh/keycloak/vigil).
- **Soak → promote:** warning rules flip to `critical` after 14 clean days; suppress noisy Suricata SIDs in `rules.yml` (`alert_signature_id NOT IN (...)`).

panels.title: Argos — incremental beacon detector (dashboard-only during A10/A11)
Argos checkpoint lag (minutes)
panels.description: Time since the durable network-beacon ingestion watermark advanced.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ifNull(dateDiff('minute', max(ingestion_watermark), now()), 0) AS value FROM argos.detector_checkpoint_history WHERE detector_id = 'network-beacon'

panels.title: Argos retention headroom (hours)
panels.description: Declared 14-day Zeek retention remaining from the durable checkpoint watermark.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ifNull(dateDiff('hour', now(), max(ingestion_watermark) + INTERVAL 14 DAY), 0) AS value FROM argos.detector_checkpoint_history WHERE detector_id = 'network-beacon'

panels.title: Argos failed cycles (24h)
panels.description: Failed current attempts; successful retries do not remain visible here.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS value FROM argos.detector_runs_current WHERE detector_id = 'network-beacon' AND status = 'failed' AND finished_at >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR

panels.title: Argos data gaps (24h)
panels.description: Explicit source-retention-gap checkpoint advances. Any non-zero value requires review.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS value FROM argos.detector_checkpoint_history WHERE detector_id = 'network-beacon' AND advancement_reason = 'source_retention_gap' AND completed_at >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR

panels.title: Argos candidate findings
panels.description: Evidence-backed candidate findings only. Source endpoints are resolved through network.mac_ip_history and network.mac_first_seen; a blank hostname/MAC means the address was never observed by the VyOS, GigaHub, or QSS exporters.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT f.last_evaluated_at AS time, f.finding_id, f.detector_version, splitByChar('
', f.subject_canonical)[1] AS source_ip, src.hostname AS source_hostname, src.mac AS source_mac, dev.first_seen AS source_first_seen, splitByChar('
', f.subject_canonical)[2] AS destination_ip, splitByChar('
', f.subject_canonical)[3] AS destination_port, splitByChar('
', f.subject_canonical)[4] AS protocol, f.score, f.confidence, f.summary, f.baseline_revision FROM argos.findings_current AS f LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ip, argMax(mac, last_seen) AS mac, argMax(hostname, last_seen) AS hostname FROM network.mac_ip_history GROUP BY ip ) AS src ON src.ip = lower(splitByChar('
', f.subject_canonical)[1]) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT mac, min(first_seen) AS first_seen FROM network.mac_first_seen GROUP BY mac ) AS dev ON dev.mac = src.mac WHERE f.detector_id = 'network-beacon' AND f.domain = 'security' AND f.disposition = 'candidate' ORDER BY f.last_evaluated_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Argos endpoint attribution coverage (%)
panels.description: Share of current candidate findings whose source IP resolves to a known MAC. A low value means the A11 top-50 review will be mostly unattributed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100 * countIf(src.mac != '') / greatest(count(), 1), 1) AS value FROM argos.findings_current AS f LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ip, argMax(mac, last_seen) AS mac FROM network.mac_ip_history GROUP BY ip ) AS src ON src.ip = lower(splitByChar('\n', f.subject_canonical)[1]) WHERE f.detector_id = 'network-beacon' AND f.domain = 'security' AND f.disposition = 'candidate'

panels.title: vigil — Cloud Audit (AWS / GCP / OCI / Tailscale / Cloudflare)
Collectors OK (last run)

targets.rawSql: SELECT collector, count() AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['collector'] AS collector, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='vigil_collector_run_ok' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], ServiceName) WHERE v=1 GROUP BY collector ORDER BY collector

panels.description: vigil_collector_run_ok == 1 per collector. A missing collector means its last run failed or it has never run.

panels.title: Events last hour

targets.rawSql: SELECT provider, sum(d) AS value FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, Attributes['provider'] AS provider, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d)) AS d FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 70 MINUTE AND TimeUnix <= now() AND MetricName='vigil_collector_run_events' WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY provider ORDER BY provider

panels.description: Audit events emitted per provider in the last hour (0 is normal for quiet feeds).

panels.title: Oldest feed staleness

targets.rawSql: SELECT Attributes['collector'] AS collector, toFloat64(now()) - max(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='vigil_collector_last_success_timestamp_seconds' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 26 HOUR GROUP BY collector ORDER BY value DESC

panels.description: Seconds since each collector's last successful collect (push-gauges go stale ~5m after a run; the 26h max_over_time wrapper keeps daily snapshot collectors visible between runs, matching the feed-absent rule).

panels.title: Runs failed (1h)

targets.rawSql: SELECT collector, count() AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['collector'] AS collector, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='vigil_collector_run_ok' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], ServiceName) WHERE v=0 GROUP BY collector ORDER BY collector

panels.description: Collectors whose most recent run failed in the last hour.

panels.title: vigil pod ready

targets.rawSql: SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_deployment_status_replicas_available' AND Attributes['namespace']='cloud-audit' AND Attributes['deployment']='vigil' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE

panels.description: Available replicas of the vigil Deployment. 0 = pod down or never scheduled; k8s-replicaset-not-ready is the alert for this.

panels.title: vigil pod restarts (24h)

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(d) AS value FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d)) AS d FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1450 MINUTE AND TimeUnix <= now() AND MetricName='kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total' AND Attributes['namespace']='cloud-audit' AND Attributes['container']='vigil' WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR

panels.description: Container restarts in 24h. k8s-container-restart-loop alerts at >=5.

panels.title: vigil loop iterations (5m)

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS value FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND startsWith(ServiceName,'cloud-audit/vigil') AND positionCaseInsensitive(Body,'iteration complete')>0

panels.description: Stdout 'iteration complete' lines in 5m (~1/min expected). 0 = process hung or pod down; cloud-audit-loop-absent is the alert.

panels.title: Recent cloud-audit events (24h)

targets.rawSql: SELECT Timestamp AS time, ResourceAttributes['provider'] AS provider, ResourceAttributes['collector'] AS collector, JSONExtractString(Body,'event_name') AS event_name, JSONExtractString(Body,'event_time') AS event_time, JSONExtractString(Body,'principal') AS principal, JSONExtractString(Body,'resource') AS resource, JSONExtractString(Body,'outcome') AS outcome FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND ServiceName='vigil' AND ResourceAttributes['domain']='security' AND JSONHas(Body,'event_name') ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

panels.description: Newest audit events across all vigil collectors (envelope fields only; raw is in the record).
